name: Credit risk and model validation
description: 300,000 mortgages and 20.15 million monthly records. Chronological SQL snapshots, censored outcomes, fixed models and economic-stress validation. Better held-out discrimination did not justify unchanged probabilities: calibration failures are disclosed.
roles: Credit risk, model validation, risk analytics

name: Insurance pricing and reserve uncertainty
description: French motor pricing and a separate US auto-reserving study. Fixed pricing comparisons and reserve interval scores expose conditional-calibration and coverage failures. The two populations are not joined.
roles: Actuarial analytics, insurance risk, uncertainty modelling

name: Causal customer decisions
description: A 64,000-customer, three-arm randomized experiment. Frozen policies and doubly robust evaluation did not establish that personalized targeting beats the selected simple campaign. Explicit margin and contact costs are scenarios.

name: Treasury ALM and liquidity
description: Interest-rate hedging, published Treasury curves and hypothetical benefit cash flows. Four hedge policies, 56 rate stresses and 108 liquidity-runoff cases. Independent Decimal and formula-workbook reconciliations support the modelling.

name: Demand, capital and inventory
description: 210 historical M5 item-store series link probabilistic forecasts to replenishment under common capital/capacity constraints. Fifteen final weekly origins and overlapping horizons limit inference. Operating effects are simulations, not observed retailer savings.
roles: Business analytics, forecasting, operations and working capital

name: Indian inflation release vintages
description: 48 official releases and 144 vintage observations. An 18-release final check retains persistence: RMSE 0.8185 pp versus 1.6901 for fixed AR(1). Release dates and the later base revision remain separate. No current inflation forecast is claimed.
roles: Economic research, time series, publication-aware data

name: Corporate Finance Decision Lab
description: Nine issuer reports, a traced financial spread and a funded-growth policy model. Final extraction: 33 supported correct /36 financial targets for both methods, three justified abstentions. 519 independent valuation checks and a reconciled formula workbook.
roles: Corporate finance, FP&A, financial research and finance data
